slides.headline: A garden gate. Two young lovers have to say *goodbye*.
He leans over the iron gate, close to her *face*.
She tilts her head toward him, eyes *lowered*.
Through the bars, their hands hold on *tight*.
Her other hand touches her neck, *nervous*.
Between them, the cold iron bars of the *gate*.
She wears a hat with bright yellow *ribbons*.
Scissors hang from her waist. She left her work to *come*.
Autumn leaves cover the path. Summer is *over*.
Tissot painted it in London, after fleeing *Paris*.
Will he come back for her? Or is this *goodbye*?
